"""Forms the script reports instead of guessing."""

import importlib

import threetears.evals.schema
from threetears.evals import kernel
from threetears.evals import host as evals_host
from threetears.evals.kernel import *


def walk() -> object:
    for mod_name in ("threetears.evals.schema", "threetears.evals.kernel"):
        importlib.import_module(mod_name)
    getattr(kernel, "EvalServiceError")
    return __import__("threetears.evals.ops"), evals_host.EvalServiceError
